name: Hot Cocoa Magic!
source:
"Hot Cocoa Magic!" is a kinetic visual novel about a socially anxious witch and the power of hot cocoa!

[From [url=https://ekkoberry.itch.io/hot-cocoa-magic]Itch.io[/url]]

This is a small visual novel made for Winter VN Jam 2022.
